page.layout: One page of text, single column, centred dedication lines; no margin notes; no page number or running head.

main_text.head: Illustrissimo & Nobilissimo Viro DOMINO D. JOSEPHO WILLIAMSON EQUITI AURATO, REGI ABOMNIBUS CONSILIIS ET SECRETIS REGIÆ SCIENTIARUM SOCIETATIS PRÆSIDI NERITISSIMO, INGENIO PRÆSTANTI, ET ERUDITIONE PERFECTA ORNATO, JUDICIO ACRI, ET MEMORIA ADMIRABILI PRÆDITO, INDUSTRIA IN AGENDO, CONSILIO IN PROVIDENDO UT STUDIO ET FIDELITATE IN RELIGIONEM, REGEM, REMPUBLICAM NULLI SECUNDO, SUMMO LITERATORUM FAUTORI, LITERARUM SCIENTIÆ ET ELOQUENDI ELEGANTIÆ, AMPLIFICATORI
main_text.p: Hoc qualecunque opusculum dicat, vovet, ac consecrat inprimis addictus, deditus, & obstrictus

page.notes: The dedication is set in mixed roman, italic, small capitals and display sizes; the headline is rendered as one head, with the display lines run together. The signature "Carolus Maria de Veïl" is in italic, set right-aligned. Some letters in the scan are damaged (e.g. "Hoc qualecunque opusculum", "addictus", "obstrictus" with worn letters), but the readings are clear enough. A small mark is visible at the bottom left of the page, not transcribed.
